tools.name: capmo_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects the API key's user can access, one page at a time. Use it first to find a project id. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects.

tools.name: capmo_get_project
tools.description: Get one project: name, address, status phase, client, responsible contact, type, and start and end dates. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_project_tickets
tools.description: List the tickets (defects, tasks, issues) of one project, one page at a time. Each ticket has name, status, deadline, company, responsible users and cost. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets.

tools.name: capmo_get_project_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket with its status, description, deadline, cost, company and plan location. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one ticket, one page at a time. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: capmo_list_ticket_categories
tools.description: List the ticket categories of one project. Use their ids as category_id when you create or update a ticket. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/ticket-categories.

tools.name: capmo_create_project_ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket in one project. Writes a new record to the customer's Capmo project. Status defaults to OPEN. Capmo API: POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets.

tools.name: capmo_update_project_ticket
tools.description: Change fields of one ticket. Only the fields you pass change; send null to clear a nullable field. Capmo API: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_project_people
tools.description: List the contacts in one project's contact book (name, email, position, company). Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/people.

tools.name: capmo_list_project_companies
tools.description: List the companies in one project's contact book (trades and contractors on the project). Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/companies.

tools.name: capmo_list_organisation_people
tools.description: List the contacts in the organisation's contact book, optionally filtered by email. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/organisation/people.

tools.name: capmo_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents of one project (name, type, size, version, folder). Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/document-files.

tools.name: capmo_get_document
tools.description: Get one project document with its name, mime type, size, version number and folder. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/document-files/{fileId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_plans
tools.description: List the plans (drawings) of one project. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/plans.

tools.name: capmo_get_plan
tools.description: Get one plan with its name, folder, file, status and version. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/plans/{planId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_site_journals
tools.description: List the site journals (daily site reports) of one project. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/site-journals.

tools.name: capmo_get_site_journal
tools.description: Get one site journal: date, weather, company attendances, visits and custom texts. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/site-journals/{siteJournalId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_change_orders
tools.description: List the change orders of one project (name, cost, step, assignee, completion). Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/change-orders.

tools.name: capmo_get_change_order
tools.description: Get one change order with its reason, cost, companies, assignees, step and description. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/change-orders/{changeOrderId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_change_order_steps
tools.description: List the workflow steps a change order can sit in for one project. Use their ids as step_id. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/change-orders/steps.

tools.name: capmo_create_change_order
tools.description: Create a change order in one project. Writes a new record to the customer's Capmo project. Capmo API: POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/change-orders.

tools.name: capmo_update_change_order
tools.description: Change fields of one change order. Only the fields you pass change; send null to clear a nullable field. Capmo API: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/change-orders/{changeOrderId}.

tools.name: capmo_list_room_listings
tools.description: List the room listings (rooms and spaces) of one project. Capmo API: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/room-listings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: capmo_list_project_tickets, capmo_get_project_ticket, capmo_list_ticket_comments, capmo_list_ticket_categories, capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_organisation_people · Private data: capmo_list_projects, capmo_get_project, capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_project_companies, capmo_list_organisation_people, capmo_list_documents, capmo_get_document, capmo_get_plan, capmo_create_change_order · Public sink: capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_update_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_organisation_people, capmo_create_change_order, capmo_update_change_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: capmo_list_project_tickets, capmo_get_project_ticket, capmo_list_ticket_comments, capmo_list_ticket_categories, capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_organisation_people · Private data: capmo_list_projects, capmo_get_project, capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_project_companies, capmo_list_organisation_people, capmo_list_documents, capmo_get_document, capmo_get_plan, capmo_create_change_order · Public sink: capmo_create_project_ticket, capmo_update_project_ticket, capmo_list_project_people, capmo_list_organisation_people, capmo_create_change_order, capmo_update_change_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
